messages:
Maya (Engineer): Quick question 10-night stay split charge. My corpcard shows a single charge to "AIRBNB HOSTING" for $1,248.00 but the nightly rates on the booking show $99/night x 9 nights + a cleaning fee and service fee. The Airbnb receipt is a single PDF with lineitems but the vendor descriptor on the bank is generic. I need to expense the stay and include per-night breakdown for client billing.
Diego (Finance): Do you have the Airbnb booking confirmation that lists nightly charges? If so attach it. For client billing we prefer per-night line items but we can accept Airbnb breakdown + a short memo reconciling totals.
Maya (Engineer): I have booking_confirmation.pdf and a csv export from Airbnb that shows the nights. Uploader: https://files.redwood/airbnb/maya_booking_2193.pdf and https://files.redwood/airbnb/maya_nights_2193.csv
Hannah (People Ops): Manager pre-approval? Also was this booked on the company travel portal?
Maya (Engineer): Manager OK (Slack note: "approved for client trip"), not booked on portal. I asked the host for an itemized folio but they said Airbnb consolidates payments.
ExpenseBot: :warning: Expense flagged  vendor-descriptor mismatch for client-billable travel. Reference: EXP-CLT-2193
Diego (Finance): Filing steps: 1) Submit in Expensify under Lodging. 2) Attach booking confirmation + Airbnb csv export + manager approval screenshot. 3) In the notes field include per-night breakdown (copy from your CSV) and a reconciliation line that matches the bank total. 4) Tag the expense with client code CLT-889 for downstream billing. We'll code to GL 6100 and create a memo invoice for the client with the breakdown.
Maya (Engineer): Done  submitted https://expensify.com/receipt/RE-240900 and attached CSV + booking PDF + manager approval screenshot. Marked client code CLT-889.
Diego (Finance): Received. Marking as pending review. If the bank descriptor causes client reimbursement issues we'll reach out to the vendor/card provider to request clearer MCC/descriptor mapping.
Hannah (People Ops): Note for future  if a stay is client-billable, please flag people-ops before booking off-portal so we can help get itemized folios or book on portal.
ExpenseBot: :white_check_mark: EXP-CLT-2193 updated: finance assigned (Diego), status = pending review.
